data_fields.name: gain chance success bonus
data_fields.donor_constant: 0.5 on success, 0.2 on failure, 0 on failure under AOS

data_fields.name: skill gain factor
data_fields.donor_constant: GainFactor per skill (1 in the first rows of skills.json)

data_fields.name: stat gain cooldown
data_fields.donor_constant: 3 seconds on Core.ML, 10 minutes legacy (Core.ML ? 0.05 : 10 minutes)

best_idea: A skill rises by use: a success ramp between a min and max value, and a gain chance that falls as the skill nears its own cap and as the character nears a shared skill budget, so progression slows at the top with no level wall.
decision_why: Keep the success ramp and falling gain chance for two or three duel skills (parry, guard, dodge), rolled on the server and counted in the one ledger; drop the cross-skill drain and the stat atrophy, which move points between skills or stats in ways duel tuning cannot see.
acceptance: A server test runs 1000 seeded parry attempts at a success chance of 0.5: parry points rise, gains stop once the shared budget is full, and an attempt below the min value gains nothing and rolls nothing.
